payload.name: Preserve activity purpose tied to recovery or limitation
payload.description: When extracting a memory about an activity someone does in response to a recovery, restriction, or boredom, include the stated purpose and situational context in the memory content.
content: During extraction, when a speaker mentions an activity or hobby in direct response to a question about coping with a limitation, recovery, or restricted activity, preserve the stated purpose (e.g., 'to keep busy', 'to stay active while healing') as part of the memory content alongside the activity itself.
Do not reduce such mentions to generic enjoyment or expression; the situational context is needed to answer later questions about why or under what condition the activity was done.
During CRUD, when comparing new evidence with existing memories, update or merge memories to add missing purpose or context rather than creating a separate generic activity memory.

solves: The extracted memory omitted why Evan painted (to keep busy while healing), preserving only generic enjoyment. This occurs when an activity is described as a coping response to a limitation; future questions need that purpose. The skill applies to extraction/CRUD for activities tied to recovery, restriction, or boredom, but not when the purpose is incidental or no stated constraint.
